profiles.name: Snake Plant
profiles.careCue: Let the growing medium dry substantially before watering.

light.placement: Place near a window with good daylight. Some direct sun is fine; introduce stronger sun gradually.

profiles.name: Monstera
profiles.careCue: Check the top 1–2 inches of soil and avoid waterlogging.

light.placement: Place near a bright window, away from strong sun shining directly on the leaves.

profiles.name: Rubber Plant
profiles.careCue: Use a free-draining medium and check before watering.

light.placement: Place near a bright window, sheltered from strong afternoon sun. Daylight should reach the plant without harsh sun on its leaves.

profiles.name: Pothos
profiles.careCue: Allow the soil to dry between checks; avoid keeping it constantly wet.

light.placement: Choose a bright spot out of strong direct sun. It tolerates lower light, but grows best with plenty of indirect daylight.

profiles.name: Spider Plant
profiles.careCue: Keep the soil lightly moist, but let excess water drain away.

light.placement: Place in medium indirect light. Avoid strong direct sun; it tolerates lower light and short dry periods.
